verdicts.reason: A: the black panel has shrunk to a small 'MOVIE NIGHT' box near the bottom. All the white supporting text (title, tagline, date, address, URL) sits on the busy doodle background with no panel behind it, so it's unreadable, and the headline now comes after its own copy. B: the panel is a tiny box holding only the headline and empty rules, and every other line of text is scattered across the canvas in white on the doodles, so it's invisible and in no reading order. B is worse because its text is more scattered and harder to find; A at least keeps the text together in one block.
